name: Daft
description: Skills for working with Daft, a high-performance data engine for AI and multimodal workloads. Includes UDF performance tuning, distributed scaling with Ray, and documentation navigation.
longDescription:
Ships **3 skills**.

- **Skills** (3): `daft-distributed-scaling` (Scale Daft workflows to distributed Ray clusters), `daft-docs-navigation` (Navigate Daft documentation), `daft-udf-tuning` (Optimize Daft UDF performance)

Installs with `claude plugin install daft@claude-community` from `Eventual-Inc/Daft`.
